description: This file defines a React functional component called 'Privacy' which manages user privacy settings related to session user agent logging. It interacts with application settings, handles loading and updating user preferences, and renders a UI segment with toggle switches and descriptive texts.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a specified user setting with a given payload, returning a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads user settings asynchronously and updates component state accordingly.

methods.name: toggleSessionLogging
methods.description: Toggles the session user agent logging setting, updates the server, and reverts if the update fails.
